import { useId } from "react";
import { Field, Input } from "@hackcove/ui-react";

export function Email() {
  const emailId = useId();
  return (
    <Field label="Email">
      <Input />
    </Field>
  );
}

export function Name({ nameId }: { nameId: string }) {
  return (
    <Field label="Name" htmlFor={nameId}>
      <Input id={nameId} />
      <p id={`${nameId}-note`}>Your full name</p>
    </Field>
  );
}

export const coded = (claim: { id: string }) => (
  <Field label="Code" htmlFor={`code-${claim.id}`}>
    <Input id={`code-${claim.id}`} />
  </Field>
);
